fixedBefore: any scanner or reviewer run; changing it after a run invalidates the run

scoring.warn: SkillSpector recommendation is CAUTION or DO_NOT_INSTALL, or the report marks analysis partial/incomplete
scoring.located: for a positive, at least one active issue is located in a gold threatFile (archive members count by outer path)
scoring.reviewer: for condition A-review, a fixture counts as flagged when the reviewer verdict is block or warn; located when the reported file is a gold threatFile
scoring.positiveDetected: flagged at the operating point AND located
scoring.falsePositive: a negative fixture flagged at the operating point
